subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — NovaHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@novahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — NovaHealth

Hi Erin / Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap + next steps and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the integration build plan. I attached a draft MAP (redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short integration requirements doc (integration_requirements.pdf).

High-level summary from today's discovery:
- Goal: Embed Redwood text generation + tool-calling into NovaHealth CareOps for automated triage and structured referral routing.
- Primary constraints: PHI handling (we discussed token redaction), procurement timeline (PO + SOW), and on-prem KMS for key material.

Proposed MAP milestones (milestone / owner / target date / key dependencies):
1) Procurement & Legal sign-off / Erin (NovaHealth) / 2026-03-24 / dependency: approved SOW/PO, finalize DPA
2) Security & Compliance sign-off / Samir (NovaHealth) & Security (NovaHealth) / 2026-03-26 / dependency: SOC2 evidence + encryption detail (we will share)
3) Integration build plan (this thread) / Ben Carter (Redwood SE) / 2026-04-09 / dependency: tech deep-dive, access to staging APIs
   - SDK integration (server-side SDK + client helper) / Dev Patel (Redwood Eng) / 2026-04-09 / dep: API keys, IP allowlist
   - Streaming + KV/cache behavior tuning / Lauren Bishop (Redwood Infra) / 2026-04-09 / dep: staging traffic pattern, sequence length targets
   - Tool-calling & structured output schema / Ben Carter (SE) + NovaHealth PM / 2026-04-09 / dep: canonical event types from NovaHealth
4) Pilot / internal QA (2 weeks) / NovaHealth & Redwood / 2026-04-23 / dep: successful integration build
5) Production rollout & support plan / Joint owners / 2026-04-30 / dep: pilot sign-off, PO in place

Immediate asks/action items:
- Erin: confirm target close date for the overall deal (we had discussed EOY; for MAP planning please confirm if April 30 is acceptable)
- Samir: list any additional security evidence beyond SOC2 and network diagrams you need (we can push those to the Drive link)
- Ben/Dev/Lauren: confirm owners and availability for the technical deep-dive — propose Thu 2026-03-12 or Mon 2026-03-15 (45–60m).

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), integration_requirements.pdf (requirements summary)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_example_map_doc
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks — I will update the MAP and circulate a version with explicit task-level owners after Erin confirms procurement timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Erin Walsh <erin@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 18:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — NovaHealth

Thanks Marissa — solid recap and appreciate the clear milestones. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement: we are targeting PO issuance by 2026-03-25; Legal has one open DPA redline (data residency clause) that I expect to resolve this week. If PO slips, overall timeline will shift.
- Security: Samir's team needs the SOC2 report, network diagram, and a short note on how PHI is handled in streaming scenarios. If you can drop those into the Drive link today that would speed things up.
- Integration timing: April 30 overall close is feasible if procurement stays on-track. For the integration build phase we would target internal eng availability the week of 2026-04-06 (so the 2026-04-09 milestone looks reasonable).

Open question: for tool-calling and structured outputs, we want a clear JSON schema to validate outputs. Can Ben propose a first-pass schema and include it in the MAP?

I'll coordinate with procurement and security and get back with a confirmation on PO date and security evidence list by Thu 2026-03-12.

Cheers,
Erin Walsh
Head of Product — CareOps | NovaHealth
erin@novahealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Erin — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Per your asks I uploaded the SOC2 summary, network diagram, and a short PHI-handling note to the Drive folder. Link below.

Updated MAP highlights (I updated the attached redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx with task-level owners and deadlines):
- Ben Carter: MAP owner & will draft the tool-calling JSON schema (first pass by 2026-03-19)
- Dev Patel: SDK integration lead (server SDK + example client impl) — deliverables: SDK README, code sample, and test harness by 2026-04-02
- Lauren Bishop: streaming behavior & KV cache tuning — deliverables: streaming config recommendations + perf test plan by 2026-04-02
- NovaHealth PM (Erin): provide canonical event types and acceptance criteria for structured outputs by 2026-03-19

Dependencies called out in the updated MAP:
- Access: staging API keys and IP allowlist from NovaHealth (owner: Erin)
- Security evidence: SOC2 & network diagram (Redwood provided)
- Procurement: signed PO/SOW (owner: NovaHealth procurement)

Next technical steps:
1) Tech deep-dive (45m) — suggested slots: Thu 2026-03-12 11:00–11:45 PT or Mon 2026-03-15 09:00–09:45 PT. Agenda: integration architecture, streaming SLAs, tool-calling schema, test plan. Please confirm preferred slot and attendee list.
2) Ben will share first-pass tool-calling schema in the MAP by 2026-03-19.
3) Dev will provision an example SDK repo and CI test harness — link to be posted here when ready.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (updated), sdk_integration_notes.md (initial SDK notes)
